description: Changes: adds a note to one ticket and, when sent, moves its status (open, in progress, on hold, repaired) or its priority; never resolves, never deletes, never moves the status of a ticket that holds a room out of order. No preview: the change is made when called. Adds a note to a maintenance ticket and moves its status or priority, by the app's own rule (Maintenance › the ticket): repaired stamps who repaired it; a resolved ticket reopens only for a maintenance manager. Never resolves (a person approves a repair) and never deletes. A ticket holding a room out of order takes no status move here, in any direction (repairing, reopening or holding it changes whether the room is for sale): change it in the PMS; a note and a priority are still allowed. One of the two people the owner named. Needs the owner's sign-in.
name: update_maintenance_ticket
title: Update a maintenance ticket
